scope: GitHub handoff and fresh-clone reproducibility; no application behavior change or multi-model tool installation

fresh_clone.check_release: passed after the initial preview-start timeout and bounded recheck
fresh_clone.initial_failure: First Windows check:release passed build/static/parser stages, then timed out waiting 15000ms for the preview webServer.
fresh_clone.recheck_conditions: Existing proxy preserved; loopback hosts merged into NO_PROXY only for the test process. Same build browser recheck passed, then complete check:release passed.
fresh_clone.causality_limit: No controlled test established that proxy bypass alone caused the recovery. No application fix is claimed.

github_actions.later_documentation_commits: Verify their own run by commit; this record does not substitute for later deployment evidence.

public_safety: Authored archive checked for credential-like tokens, private keys, user-specific absolute paths and missing Markdown links. Credentials, personal backups, database files and browser sessions excluded.
cleanup_policy: After final remote verification, remove confirmed project checkouts, verification clone and owned temporary files. Preserve Desktop research, Downloads originals, this conversation, global tools/proxy settings and user browser data. No forensic-erasure claim.
